name: Nomifensine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1986 — for liver harm and blood problems

summary: Nomifensine was removed from the market worldwide starting in 1986 due to liver damage and blood problems [3]. In addition, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug a low score of 40 for both liver and heart risks [M]. These computer-calculated scores suggest low potential harm based solely on computer predictions rather than human studies [M].
